audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer chart row read 'Skill' while the content layer and packet give Malzahar levels 1-3 and 6, an even 4-5, and Diana both item stages.
audit.why: Diana is melee with a 900-range arc; pre-6 you shove her off the wave. Lunar Rush is 22s at rank 1 unless Moonlight is on the target, and Moonfall is only 475 range, so her power is item-gated.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match content; the Diana rows dropped to 4/10 and every moved why rewritten to argue that side.

audit.why: Level 6 and her first item are the two real hinges: Nether Grasp answers an un-itemised dive, and QSS or Mercs answer Nether Grasp.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said 'Moonlight marks reset her dash' without the cooldown that makes it matter, and named no other numbers.
audit.why: Lunar Rush has no cooldown against a Moonlight-marked target and 22/20/18/16/14s otherwise, so whether you eat Crescent Strike decides whether her dash is free or gone for twenty seconds.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and the trade rules now state both halves with the numbers attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit and cited a nonexistent 'Iron Boundary'.
audit.why: lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT; real numbers are Crescent Strike 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, Lunar Rush 22/20/18/16/14, Moonfall 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: Written in, with the fabricated name removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eighteen fields called Diana he/his/him, and two bullets were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists diana as she/her; lintFindings MISGENDER and COPY_PASTE_BLEED.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields corrected and both bullets rewritten to match their titles.

edits.before: - Diana Crescent Strike: matchup-defining — Moonlight marks reset her dash — sidestep the arc and her dive has no follow-up. It governs your forward steps. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Lunar Rushes' in spikes[1].text as a probable wrong name — it is a false positive: the sentence conjugates the real ability name ('she E Lunar Rushes in'). Left alone. Report edits again exceed two, but every one is a lintFindings misgender or magnitude fix rather than sweep scope. 'Iron Boundary' in breakdown.cooldowns was fabricated and is gone. Win rate here is 48.88% while the chart hands Malzahar four of seven rows; the content layer explains that as Diana's item spike inverting the lane, which is consistent, so I left the chart alone beyond making the two layers agree.
